name: worklog-restriction-manager
description: Jira Cloud Forge app that enforces company-defined time-logging policies.

scripts.build:marketplace: npm run manifest:marketplace && npm run build
scripts.build:internal: npm run manifest:internal && npm run build
scripts.deploy:marketplace: npm run build:marketplace && forge deploy -e production
scripts.deploy:internal: npm run build:internal && forge deploy -e production
scripts.deploy:marketplace:dev: npm run build:marketplace && forge deploy -e development
scripts.deploy:internal:dev: npm run build:internal && forge deploy -e development
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:bundle && npm run build
